operators.name: cross_map_lrn_forward
semantics: Computes local response normalization across channels for each spatial location: output[n, c, h, w] = input[n, c, h, w] / (k + alpha * sum_{j=max(0, c-size//2)}^{min(C-1, c+size//2)} input[n, j, h, w]^2)^{beta}.
size is an odd positive integer; the summation window size is exactly `size` (including the current channel).
Broadcasting: none, element-wise per channel with cross-channel reduction.
The op must support arbitrary strides and handle non-contiguous tensors correctly, matching PyTorch's CrossMapLRN2d behavior.
Input is expected on CUDA device; CPU tensors are not supported and should raise an error.
The computation is performed in float32 precision, matching the reference.
The entire model output is the result of CrossMapLRN2d applied to input x.
No intermediate checkpoints exist beyond the final return.
